info.name: Credit Circuit local verification
info.description: All application endpoints, authentication, validation, ownership, pagination, duplicate purchases/refunds, declines and admin status. Only fictional data. Run in order against local MySQL. Supply private variables locally; exported tokens and credentials are blank. The final rate-limit test consumes the local authentication window. The companion runner creates and cleans up its own fixtures. New ACCOUNT_V1 cards use 0000 plus the account ID padded to 12 digits, derived only in memory. Full-number matching, different owned cards and unchanged state after invalid card input are exercised.

exec: pm.test('Register USER account and card: HTTP 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
